practical_workflow: Confirm the aim, likely course length, blood-test arrangements and a working urgent contact number. DPD testing is required before starting the fluoropyrimidine unless already completed.
Confirm venous access, the 46-hour fluorouracil pump and disconnection arrangements before leaving. Know whom to contact for leakage, an alarm, line pain or a pump that finishes unexpectedly.
Ask the unit to confirm the new treatment and blood-test dates. Re-anchor supportive medicines to the treatment actually given; do not take an extra or catch-up anticancer dose yourself.
Follow your oncology unit’s urgent advice for fever, infection, severe diarrhoea, chest pain or difficulty breathing. Bring your treatment card and current medicines list.
observation_and_access: Follow local observation and hypersensitivity procedures for oxaliplatin.
Ensure a documented pump-disconnection and out-of-hours contact plan.

regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: For resectable stomach or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, cT2 or higher or node positive (NCCP 00344). ESOPEC also studied resectable oesophageal adenocarcinoma.
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Docetaxel — It holds the structures used in cell division in place so dividing cells cannot separate. Oxaliplatin — It links strands of DNA, making it harder for cells to copy them. Fluorouracil — It interferes with the building blocks cells need to make DNA and RNA. A pump gives it over 24 hours. Folinic acid — It helps fluorouracil block a DNA-making enzyme for longer.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: Four cycles before surgery, then four after recovery. Each cycle is 14 days. Cycle 5 usually starts 6–12 weeks after the operation.
key_points: Four cycles before surgery, then four after recovery. Each cycle is 14 days. Cycle 5 usually starts 6–12 weeks after the operation.
Day 1 pump connection and day 2 disconnection.
Nivolumab after neoadjuvant chemoradiation and residual disease is a separate pathway. Residual disease after FLOT alone does not establish this indication.

Review perioperative FLOT by phase. Plan the 24-hour fluorouracil pump disconnection and reconcile the docetaxel steroid premedication with the antiemetic steroid. The postoperative course requires a fresh assessment after surgery.

patient_selection.treatment_intent: Shrink the cancer before surgery and treat microscopic cancer cells that could cause recurrence afterwards. The aim is cure.
disease_and_biomarker_context: For resectable stomach or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma, cT2 or higher or node positive (NCCP 00344). ESOPEC also studied resectable oesophageal adenocarcinoma.
eligibility_orientation: NCCP criteria include ECOG 0–2 and adequate marrow, kidney and liver function. Confirm the anatomical site, histology and multidisciplinary plan.
important_cautions: Before cycle 5, reassess surgical healing, infection, hydration, nutritional intake, performance status and residual toxicity. The interval alone cannot establish fitness.

administration.cycle_and_sequence: Four cycles before surgery, then four after recovery. Each cycle is 14 days. Cycle 5 usually starts 6–12 weeks after the operation.
route_and_duration: Day 1 docetaxel 50 mg/m² over 1 hour, oxaliplatin 85 mg/m² and folinic acid 200 mg/m² over 2 hours, followed by fluorouracil 2600 mg/m² over 24 hours.
practical_workflow: Disconnect the ambulatory pump on day 2. Arrange disconnect and line-care access before each infusion.
Confirm dexamethasone premedication taken from the day before docetaxel.
observation_and_access: Observe for infusion hypersensitivity. Cold-triggered throat symptoms need immediate assessment during infusion.

supportive_care.emetogenic_risk: Moderate. Reconcile docetaxel premedication with antiemetics so dexamethasone is prescribed only once.
premedication_and_prophylaxis: Take prescribed dexamethasone beginning the day before each infusion. Bring the times and doses taken. If you miss a dose, ring before attending. The team reconciles this with anti-sickness steroids.
After a fever with low white cells or a treatment delay from low white cells, your team may prescribe growth-factor injections. Confirm the dates with your team.
patient_education: Follow your signed anti-sickness prescription. Contact the unit if vomiting continues or fluids will not stay down.
Small frequent meals and drinks can be easier. Contact your dietitian if your weight falls or feeds are difficult. Ask about support for fatigue.
special_support: Review medicines for CYP3A inhibitors or inducers affecting docetaxel. Fluorouracil can increase INR with warfarin and raise phenytoin concentrations. Coordinate monitoring with pharmacy.

baseline: Blood counts, kidney and liver function and a DPD test. Low DPD activity can make fluorouracil dangerous.
before_each_cycle: Repeat blood counts, kidney and liver tests. Report tingling or numbness. The team assesses nerves at least every two cycles and sooner if needed.
ongoing: Surgical recovery, eating and drinking, weight, activity, blood results and lasting side effects.
priority_toxicities: Fever with neutropenia, diarrhoea, mucositis, fluorouracil-associated chest pain, oxaliplatin neuropathy and infusion reactions.
urgent_review_signals: Fever or rigors, chest pain, breathing difficulty, inability to keep fluids down or rapidly worsening diarrhoea require urgent assessment.

regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: First-line treatment of adults with unresectable or metastatic biliary tract cancer. Cycles 1–8 at most: day 1 all three infusions; day 8 gemcitabine and cisplatin only. Each cycle lasts 21 days. From cycle 9, if continuing: durvalumab alone every 28 days.
regimen_profiles.treatment_setting: First-line treatment of adults with unresectable or metastatic biliary tract cancer.
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Durvalumab blocks PD-L1. Gemcitabine interferes with DNA synthesis and cisplatin forms DNA crosslinks. The two cytotoxics are confined to induction.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: Cycles 1–8 at most: day 1 all three infusions; day 8 gemcitabine and cisplatin only. Each cycle lasts 21 days. From cycle 9, if continuing: durvalumab alone every 28 days.
key_points: Cycles 1–8 at most: day 1 all three infusions; day 8 gemcitabine and cisplatin only. Each cycle lasts 21 days. From cycle 9, if continuing: durvalumab alone every 28 days.

Before starting: blood count, kidney and liver profile, glucose and thyroid function. Hearing assessment if indicated. During treatment: day 1 full blood count, kidney and liver checks; during chemotherapy day 8 full blood count and creatinine; regular glucose and thyroid tests, with cortisol if clinically indicated.
Cisplatin is highly emetogenic; durvalumab alone has minimal emetogenic potential. Assess fever, jaundice or rigors urgently for cholangitis, especially with a biliary stent.

Document whether the visit is day 1 or day 8 of combination therapy, or durvalumab maintenance. Gemcitabine and cisplatin stop after up to eight 21-day cycles. From cycle 9 durvalumab alone follows a 28-day cycle if appropriate.

priority_toxicities: Lung inflammation (pneumonitis) — Contact oncology urgently for a new cough or breathlessness. Severe trouble breathing or chest pain needs 112 or 999.
Bowel inflammation (colitis) — Call oncology urgently for new diarrhoea, blood in stools or increasing abdominal pain.
Liver inflammation or bile drainage problems — Call urgently for yellow eyes or skin, dark urine or worsening upper abdominal pain.
Hormone problems — Unusual thirst, frequent urination, dizziness, vomiting, marked weakness or severe headache need urgent assessment. Collapse or confusion with severe illness needs emergency help.
Infection or blocked bile duct — Fever, shivering, jaundice or upper abdominal pain need urgent assessment, especially with a biliary stent.
Kidneys, hearing or nerves — Report much less urine, ringing in the ears, hearing changes or tingling promptly.
monitoring_and_toxicity.disease_monitoring: Follow the individual treatment plan; the source does not prescribe a fixed imaging interval.

test_specific_details.label: Before
test_specific_details.purpose: Blood count, kidney and liver function, glucose and thyroid function Baseline results help the team recognise changes.

test_specific_details.label: Before, if needed
test_specific_details.purpose: Hearing assessment Your team may refer you if hearing or tinnitus is a concern.

test_specific_details.label: During treatment
test_specific_details.purpose: Day 1: blood count, kidney and liver tests. Day 8 in the chemotherapy phase: blood count and creatinine. Cisplatin can injure the kidneys. Your team checks results before giving treatment.

test_specific_details.label: During treatment
test_specific_details.purpose: Glucose and thyroid function regularly; cortisol if clinically indicated. New weakness, dizziness or vomiting may prompt hormone tests.

test_specific_details.label: Local plan
test_specific_details.purpose: Your unit may request additional tests, such as hepatitis screening, depending on its policy or your history. The Irish biliary protocol does not specify routine hepatitis testing or mandatory PD-L1 tumour testing.

administration.cycle_and_sequence: Cycles 1–8 at most: day 1 all three infusions; day 8 gemcitabine and cisplatin only. Each cycle lasts 21 days. From cycle 9, if continuing: durvalumab alone every 28 days.
administration.route_and_duration: Induction day 1: durvalumab ~60 min, gemcitabine ~30 min, cisplatin ~60 min; induction day 8: gemcitabine and cisplatin only. Allow additional time for fluids and monitoring.
practical_workflow: Record the treatment phase and day before interpreting counts, renal function, hydration and antiemetics.

evidence_at_a_glance.population: 685 previously untreated patients with advanced biliary tract cancer in a phase 3 randomised trial.
evidence_at_a_glance.comparison: Durvalumab plus gemcitabine/cisplatin followed by durvalumab versus placebo plus gemcitabine/cisplatin followed by placebo.
evidence_at_a_glance.applicability: First-line treatment of adults with unresectable or metastatic biliary tract cancer.
evidence_at_a_glance.qualitative_result: The TOPAZ-1 trial compared adding durvalumab to gemcitabine and cisplatin with adding a placebo. At the three-year analysis, about 15 in 100 people in the durvalumab group and 7 in 100 in the placebo group were alive after three years.
limitations: These are results in selected trial groups. They cannot predict an individual response; ask how the findings apply to you.
